_comment: Single source of truth for the Content-Security-Policy. vercel.json serves it and scripts/verify-csp.mjs proves it in a real browser; the script fails if the two drift. expectedBlocked documents anything the policy is meant to block on purpose - it is empty because nothing currently should be, and it is kept empty on purpose: an entry here silences a violation, so leaving a resolved one in place would hide the same tracker if it ever returned. Two advertising endpoints have appeared so far and BOTH were fixed at the source rather than allowlisted. (1) A GTM-injected Meta Pixel, 2026-08-06, setting an _fbp cookie before consent; the tag was removed from the container. (2) GA4 conversion pings to pagead2.googlesyndication.com carrying the page URL, the page title and a gacid client identifier, attempted even with the consent signal denied (gcs=G100, npa=1). Cause: a GA4-to-Google-Ads link to account Digitizer 299-357-1794 created 2026-08-06. Disabling Personalized Advertising did NOT stop them; deleting the link did, and all 15 pages went silent. Time elapsed between the two changes, so this does not strictly isolate which one mattered - but the endpoint is conversion measurement, which belongs to the link rather than to personalisation. If these pings ever reappear, the CSP will turn the gate red again, which is the intended behaviour.
policy: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://*.clarity.ms; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://www.googletagmanager.com https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.googletagmanager.com https://*.clarity.ms; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.googletagmanager.com https://*.analytics.google.com https://*.clarity.ms; frame-src https://www.googletagmanager.com; manifest-src 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests; report-uri /api/csp-report/; report-to csp
